name: io.github.younghwan91/kiwoom-client
title: Kiwoom Securities (키움증권) REST API
description: Korean stocks via the Kiwoom REST API: quotes, charts, rankings, account. Live orders opt-in only.

environmentVariables.name: KIWOOM_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Kiwoom REST API app key (키움 REST API 앱키)

environmentVariables.name: KIWOOM_IS_MOCK
environmentVariables.description: true = paper trading server (모의투자). Default false = live server.

environmentVariables.name: KIWOOM_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated modules to expose, e.g. market,chart,account. Default: all.

environmentVariables.name: KIWOOM_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: discovery = expose only search_tools/describe_tool/call_tool to save context.
